name: BRL1
oneLiner: BRL1 is a centralized Brazilian real stablecoin, targeting a 1:1 peg with a BRL reserve mix of Brazilian Treasury ETFs, repo agreements, and cash equivalents.
collateral: Brazilian-real reserve portfolio backing BRL1 at a 1:1 target, including Brazilian Treasury ETFs, repo agreements, and cash equivalents
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption route designed to maintain 1 BRL1 = 1 BRL through Brazilian-real backing

mintAuthority.summary: BRL1 is issued by a consortium of Brazilian exchanges (Bitso, Mercado Bitcoin, Foxbit, Cainvest). The Polygon ERC1967/UUPS token (ERC20F implementation) uses AccessControl: DEFAULT_ADMIN is an EOA (0xccfc24), MINTER_ROLE is an EOA (0x04412a), UPGRADER_ROLE is an EOA (0xf0e67f). No proxy admin slot; contract upgrade path controlled by UPGRADER_ROLE EOA.

controls.label: BRL1 consortium issuance backend
controls.evidence: Mint/burn restricted to whitelisted institutional partners who deposit BRL via PIX; the consortium backend creates BRL1 supply against custodied BRL reserves. No permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.

review.evidence: On-chain verification at Polygon block 88288928: ERC1967/UUPS proxy (ERC20F implementation, AccessControl-based). DEFAULT_ADMIN = EOA 0xccfc24f563fbd798f171d16cc0706529c4739217. MINTER_ROLE = EOA 0x04412afc0a6fa21b255c6ccff28e97073d7750b3. UPGRADER_ROLE = EOA 0xf0e67fb618496fbe0a44934d370738a611bc8fd1. All confirmed EOA via eth_getCode. RoleGranted events show 6 grants total; 0 RoleRevoked events. PAUSER_ROLE (0x65d7a28e) granted to 0xb190f8 (EOA), RECOVERY_ROLE (0x2ce8d04a) to 0xd81d41 (EOA), SALVAGE_ROLE (0x0acf8056) to 0x91f87c (EOA) — non-mint roles. No proxy admin slot set (EIP-1967 admin slot returns zero); upgrade controlled by UPGRADER_ROLE EOA. The confirmed minter and admin EOAs belong to the issuer-consortium backend, corroborating the issuer-direct model.
